items_amounts_not_negative.name: items_amounts_not_negative
items_amounts_not_negative.value: coalesce("items"."retail_price", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("items"."reorder_level", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("items"."weight", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("items"."volume", 0) >= 0

journals_reversal_is_whole.name: journals_reversal_is_whole
journals_reversal_is_whole.value: ("journals"."reverses_journal_id" is null and "journals"."source_type" <> 'reversal') or ("journals"."reverses_journal_id" is not null and "journals"."source_type" = 'reversal' and "journals"."source_id" = "journals"."reverses_journal_id")

manual_journals_posted_is_whole.name: manual_journals_posted_is_whole
manual_journals_posted_is_whole.value: ("manual_journals"."status" = 'draft') = ("manual_journals"."number" is null) and ("manual_journals"."status" = 'draft') = ("manual_journals"."journal_id" is null) and ("manual_journals"."status" = 'draft') = ("manual_journals"."posted_at" is null) and ("manual_journals"."status" = 'draft') = ("manual_journals"."posted_by" is null)

manual_journals_reversed_is_whole.name: manual_journals_reversed_is_whole
manual_journals_reversed_is_whole.value: ("manual_journals"."status" = 'reversed') = ("manual_journals"."reversal_journal_id" is not null) and ("manual_journals"."status" = 'reversed') = ("manual_journals"."reversed_at" is not null) and ("manual_journals"."status" = 'reversed') = ("manual_journals"."reversed_by" is not null)

fiscal_periods_whole_month.name: fiscal_periods_whole_month
fiscal_periods_whole_month.value: extract(day from "fiscal_periods"."starts_on") = 1 and "fiscal_periods"."ends_on" = ("fiscal_periods"."starts_on" + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date

opening_balances_kind_is_whole.name: opening_balances_kind_is_whole
opening_balances_kind_is_whole.value:
("opening_balances"."kind" = 'account' and "opening_balances"."account_id" is not null and "opening_balances"."customer_id" is null and "opening_balances"."supplier_id" is null and "opening_balances"."document_number" is null and "opening_balances"."document_date" is null and "opening_balances"."due_date" is null)
        or ("opening_balances"."kind" = 'receivable' and "opening_balances"."account_id" is null and "opening_balances"."customer_id" is not null and "opening_balances"."supplier_id" is null and "opening_balances"."document_number" is not null and "opening_balances"."document_date" is not null and "opening_balances"."credit" = 0)
        or ("opening_balances"."kind" = 'payable' and "opening_balances"."account_id" is null and "opening_balances"."customer_id" is null and "opening_balances"."supplier_id" is not null and "opening_balances"."document_number" is not null and "opening_balances"."document_date" is not null and "opening_balances"."debit" = 0)

opening_entries_posted_is_whole.name: opening_entries_posted_is_whole
opening_entries_posted_is_whole.value: ("opening_entries"."status" = 'draft') = ("opening_entries"."journal_id" is null) and ("opening_entries"."status" = 'draft') = ("opening_entries"."posted_at" is null) and ("opening_entries"."status" = 'draft') = ("opening_entries"."posted_by" is null)

opening_entries_reversed_is_whole.name: opening_entries_reversed_is_whole
opening_entries_reversed_is_whole.value: ("opening_entries"."status" = 'reversed') = ("opening_entries"."reversal_journal_id" is not null) and ("opening_entries"."status" = 'reversed') = ("opening_entries"."reversed_at" is not null) and ("opening_entries"."status" = 'reversed') = ("opening_entries"."reversed_by" is not null)
